: Why do seasons shift, Uncle?

Samina is in class 7 and Arif in class 6, They both felt very uncomfortable
the other day. It was just the beginning of March and the day was very
hot. In the small town of Sherpur, summer had come with all its heat
and warmth, Samina and Arif had nothing much to do. While sitting idle
on the veranda, they saw their uncle, Anwar coming to them. Anwar works
at an NGO called Save the Earth. Samina and Arif started talking to
theiruncle about weather and climate.
: Children, why are you sitting idle here? You look very
unhappy!
: Uncle, it’s so hot all day long.
: And there is no electricity. We can’t use fans.
: We can’t watch television either. Uncle, why is it so hot
: In fact, we’ve an early summer this year. It’s been happening
for the last four or five years. Seasons are shifting.
: What’s shifting, Uncle?
: Summer usually starts from April. But this year it has
started in moving from April to March is a shift
or change.
: Why do seasons shift, Uncle?
: Well, it is because of climate change. And many things are
happening on this earth due to climate change. For
example, seasons are shifting, temperatures are climbing,
and sea levels are rising. If things go on like this, our
Planet Earth will be in danger.
